heroLead: Playful 1:1 sessions of games, stories, and simple poses — building focus, flexibility, and calm in a fun, friendly space made just for your child. Their first session is free.
empathyText: Children thrive when movement feels like play. Our sessions build focus, flexibility, and calm through games and stories — never pressure — in a friendly, personalised 1:1 space.
helpsH2: How yoga can help your child.
helpsSubhead: Four gentle, playful ways yoga supports children — all wrapped up in fun.

posesH2: The poses we play with, and why.
posesSubhead: Grouped by what they bring out in your child. Your teacher draws from these — they won't ask your child to do all of them.

poses.desc: "The snake" — a gentle backbend children get to hiss along with.
"Cat and cow" — a wiggly, playful flow that loosens the back.
"The puppy" — a fun upside-down stretch for the whole body.
"Standing tall like a tree" — a steady, grounding balance.
"The flamingo" — balancing on one leg, just for fun.
A playful balance that mixes focus with a little fun.
Freeze-and-balance play that builds steadiness and attention.
A fun humming breath that buzzes the wiggles away.
Slow, gentle belly breathing, like blowing up a balloon.
Smell the flower, blow out the candle — a calming little game.

poseGroups.note: Breathing is always playful and gentle — never any forceful breath-holding.

poses.desc: A short, calming story to help your child wind down.
"The cosy mouse" — a snug, restful pose children find comforting.
"The resting starfish" — a still, peaceful close to every session.

poseGroups.note: We use age-appropriate poses and avoid neck-loading inversions like headstands and shoulderstands for children.

selectionNote: Your teacher won't use all of these. They'll choose the right few for your child's age, energy, and mood that day.

faqs.a: Sessions are adapted by age and mood. Share your child's age and we'll tailor the games and poses — typically school-age, but do ask us.

faqs.q: Does my child need to be flexible or sporty?
faqs.a: Not at all. It's playful and inclusive, and every child goes at their own pace.

faqs.q: Do I need to be present?
faqs.a: Yes — a parent or guardian sets up and supervises the live 1:1, and we recommend staying within sight or earshot throughout, especially for younger children. Your teacher will guide you on what works best for your child's age.
Yes. We keep everything body-safe, avoid neck-loading inversions, and never push — fun always comes first.
A 60-minute slot, though your teacher keeps younger children engaged with shorter, varied activities.

safetyText: These playful sessions support your child's overall wellbeing — they are not medical or therapeutic treatment. Please set the session up in a clear, safe space, stay nearby to supervise (especially with younger children), and tell your teacher about any health conditions, injuries, or needs so they can adapt the play safely. If you have any concerns about your child's health, speak with your paediatrician.
metaDescription: Playful, age-appropriate 1:1 yoga for children — games, stories, and simple poses that build focus, flexibility, and calm in a fun, friendly setting. First session free.
